Ecosystem pedigree (~5%) — Score: 7/10:

 Still, it’s not a Harvard/Google/IBM level magnet for talent solely on scientific prestige.

Execution & senior technical leadership (~10%) — Score: 8/10:
The company exhibits strong execution history: real products (frequency combs, lasers, control electronics) on the market, actual funding ($5M seed with venture support), and manufacturing scaling plans.

Vescent sits comfortably above many early deep‑tech startups thanks to demonstrated hardware execution and technically seasoned leadership. But its academic impact and global talent‑pull are more modest — stronger in engineering than high‑impact scholarly output. Score: 7/10.
